facts.claim: Within hours it is oxidized to carbon dioxide
facts.problem: Minor, affects no item. A fresh carbon fourteen atom is oxidized within hours to carbon MONoxide; the step from carbon monoxide to carbon dioxide (by hydroxyl radicals) takes weeks to a few months. Saying 'within hours' for carbon dioxide compresses a months-long step; 'within months' or 'quickly oxidized, first to carbon monoxide and then to carbon dioxide' would be accurate.
